text: The shaman Hwa-rim and her protégé Bong-gil are hired by a wealthy Korean American family whose [newborn son suffers a mysterious illness|who_suffers|young children], which she blames on [a vengeful ancestor's spirit|origin|the wronged dead return]. With the feng shui master Kim Sang-deok and the mortician Yeong-geun, they [dig up the grandfather's grave|trigger|unsealing what was shut away] on a remote mountain near the North Korean border, for a fee too large to refuse. When a gravedigger cuts the head from [a human-headed snake|images|monsters and hybrid creatures], rain begins to fall.
